name: Kannou Mukashibanashi Portable
original_name: 官能昔話 ポータブル
source:
One night, a guy suddenly shows up in Himeko’s room to tell her stories. However, these stories are not your average "and they live happily ever after" type. Mix of Western and Eastern stories where Himeko will get the chance to be the heroine of every story. Besides the normal ending, there’s also alternate routes and twists that Himeko can experience.

This game focuses more on the stories rather than the characters. With all the twists in the original story. This game overall has 7 routes, including the normal route in which player have to complete first for all the characters before going through their alternative endings. After all endings are finished, player can have a trip to all the locations of the stories with the Mr. Guide.

[Edited from [url=http://bishieholic.me/2012/02/22/kannou-mukashibanashi-portable-%E5%AE%98%E8%83%BD%E6%98%94%E8%A9%B1-%E3%83%9D%E3%83%BC%E3%82%BF%E3%83%96%E3%83%AB/]Bishie Holic[/url]]
translation:
一天夜里，一名男子突然出现在姬子的房间里，要给她讲故事。不过，这些可不是普通的“从此幸福地生活在一起”式童话。故事融合东西方传说，姬子有机会成为每一篇故事的女主角。除了正常结局，她还能经历各种不同路线与剧情转折。

本作更重视故事而非角色，并为原有故事加入了大量变化。游戏总共有七条路线，其中包括正常路线。玩家必须先让所有角色完成正常路线，才能进入各自的另一种结局。看完全部结局后，玩家还可以与导游先生一同游览故事中的所有地点。
